caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of textile with frayed edges, centered on a light beige background. The textile features a repeating vertical pattern composed of alternating wavy lines and stylized botanical designs. The color palette includes a black background for the textile, with the patterns rendered in shades of white, blue, and gray. The wavy lines are predominantly white with small, regularly spaced diagonal stripes, while the botanical motifs consist of blue and white leaves, arranged along twisting stems. The regular alignment and repetition of the patterns create an orderly and geometric composition. The background of the artwork is plain and has faint stains and discolorations, contributing no additional pattern or color to the image.
title: Calico
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
